The memorandum is currently under review and will be circulated this year.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration request entities to enhance monitoring of the expenditure under consultants and experts and to keep it to a minimum in accordance with the request of the General Assembly.
history.administration_response: Heads of entity and programme managers are aware of the request from the General Assembly and were encouraged to keep provisions for consultants to a minimum. In formulating budget proposals, programme managers are required to balance the need to implement mandates in an efficient and effective manner, and to use realistic assumptions that factor in past trends in their budget proposals (see A/72/5 (Vol. I), chap. II, para. 324). Programme managers were delegated authority to redeploy funds across non-post budget classes to best implement their mandates, and the overexpenditure on consultants was more than offset by underexpenditure in other non-post budget classes. The Administration monitors the use of delegated authority to ensure that the delegates comply with the applicable legal and policy framework and internal controls. Material variances at the section level or budget class level will be justified in the context of the financial performance report, in accordance with established practice. The Administration requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration requested entities to enhance monitoring of the expenditures under consultants and experts in a memorandum on budget implementation, and had made notable efforts towards monitoring the use of delegated authority, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
